## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Badge to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** None: Badge only needs the files below.
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add this line directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { Badge, BadgeAnchor, BadgeRemove, badgeClassName } from '@/ui/components/badge';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Badge

A small inline label for status or metadata. Server Component–safe; only the remove button is a client component.

#### Anatomy
- `<span class="ui-badge [ui-badge-<variant>] [ui-badge-<size>] [ui-badge-solid]" [data-live]>` — optional `<span class="ui-badge-dot" aria-hidden="true">`, then an optional icon and the text.
- `BadgeRemove`: `<button type="button" class="ui-badge-remove" aria-label="Remove …">` with a 12px `x` icon (client component).
- `BadgeAnchor`: `<span class="ui-badge-anchor">` wrapping an element and a Badge; the badge is pinned top-right.

#### Props
- `variant`: `default` · `secondary` · `outline` · `success` · `warning` · `destructive` · `info`.
- `size`: `sm` 20px · `md` 24px (default) · `lg` 28px.
- `solid`: status tones only, solid fill instead of tint. `dot`: leading status dot. `live`: pulsing dot (implies dot). `asChild`: render the child.

#### Visual rules
- Pill (`border-radius: 9999px`), 1px border, text 12px/500 (`lg` 13px), gap 6px, padding-inline 10px (sm 8, lg 12).
- default: `--ui-primary` / `--ui-primary-foreground`. secondary: `--ui-secondary`. outline: transparent + `--ui-border-strong`.
- Status tones: background `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-<tone>) 10%, transparent)`, border 24% mix, text `--ui-<tone>-text`, dot `--ui-<tone>`. Solid: fill `--ui-<tone>`, text `--ui-<tone>-foreground`.
- Dot 6px (sm 5, lg 7). Live ring: `::after` scaling 1 to 2.6 and fading, 1.8s infinite.
- Remove button 16px, opacity .7 (1 on hover/focus), hit area extended 4px by `::after`.
- Anchor badge: absolute top/right, `translate: 40% -40%`, min-width 20px, centred, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ui-background)`, `ui-pop-in` on mount.

#### Accessibility
- Plain text in a span, no role. The dot is `aria-hidden`; meaning lives in the text. Counters carry visually hidden text ("3 unread").
- BadgeRemove has a label naming what it removes; keyboard focus shows a ring.

#### Acceptance checks
- Heights 20/24/28. Status tones readable in light and dark (axe passes). Clicking a remove button removes its tag and keeps the others.

### `ui/components/badge/badge-remove.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

export interface BadgeRemoveProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {}

/**
 * The × inside a removable Badge. A client component (it takes `onClick`);
 * the Badge around it stays a Server Component.
 * Give it an `aria-label` that names what is removed: "Remove design".
 */
export const BadgeRemove = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, BadgeRemoveProps>(function BadgeRemove(
  { className, type, 'aria-label': ariaLabel = 'Remove', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type={type ?? 'button'} className={cn('ui-badge-remove', className)} aria-label={ariaLabel} {...props}>
      <Icon name="x" size={12} strokeWidth={2} />
    </button>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/badge/badge.tsx`

```tsx
import { cloneElement, forwardRef, isValidElement, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';

export type BadgeVariant = 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'destructive' | 'info';
export type BadgeSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface BadgeProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  /** Colour. `default`, `secondary` and `outline` are neutral; the rest are status tones. Default `default`. */
  variant?: BadgeVariant;
  /** Height and padding: 20 / 24 / 28px. Default `md`. */
  size?: BadgeSize;
  /** Status tones only: a solid fill instead of the faint tint (e.g. a counter). */
  solid?: boolean;
  /** Show a leading status dot in the tone colour. */
  dot?: boolean;
  /** Pulsing dot for something happening right now. Implies `dot`. */
  live?: boolean;
  /** Render the child element instead (e.g. a link), keeping badge styles. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export function badgeClassName({
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'md',
  solid = false,
  className,
}: Pick<BadgeProps, 'variant' | 'size' | 'solid' | 'className'> = {}) {
  return cn(
    'ui-badge',
    variant !== 'default' && `ui-badge-${variant}`,
    size !== 'md' && `ui-badge-${size}`,
    solid && 'ui-badge-solid',
    className,
  );
}

/**
 * Badge — a small label for status or metadata. Server Component–safe.
 * Put an `Icon` or text inside; add `dot` / `live` for a status dot.
 */
export const Badge = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BadgeProps>(function Badge(
  { variant, size, solid, dot, live, asChild = false, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const classes = badgeClassName({ variant, size, solid, className });
  if (asChild) {
    let content: ReactNode = children;
    // Keep the status dot: prepend it to the child's own content.
    if ((dot || live) && isValidElement(children)) {
      const child = children as ReactElement<{ children?: ReactNode }>;
      content = cloneElement(
        child,
        undefined,
        <span className="ui-badge-dot" aria-hidden="true" />,
        child.props.children,
      );
    }
    return (
      <Slot ref={ref as never} className={classes} data-live={live || undefined} {...props}>
        {content}
      </Slot>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={classes} data-live={live || undefined} {...props}>
      {(dot || live) && <span className="ui-badge-dot" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {children}
    </span>
  );
});

export interface BadgeAnchorProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {}

/**
 * Pins a Badge to the top-right corner of the element beside it
 * (an icon button, an avatar):
 * `<BadgeAnchor><Button icon aria-label="Inbox" /><Badge variant="destructive" solid size="sm">3</Badge></BadgeAnchor>`
 */
export const BadgeAnchor = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BadgeAnchorProps>(function BadgeAnchor(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-badge-anchor', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/badge.css`

```css
/* Badge -------------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-badge  + variant: (default) -secondary -outline -success -warning
                         -destructive -info
              + size:    -sm -lg (md default)      + -solid (status tones)
   Parts: .ui-badge-dot (aria-hidden; [data-live] pulses), .ui-badge-remove,
          .ui-badge-anchor > .ui-badge (pinned to the corner of its sibling)
   Status tones: faint tint + -text colour; the dot uses the fill colour.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-badge {
    --ui-badge-bg: var(--ui-primary);
    --ui-badge-fg: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    --ui-badge-border: transparent;
    --ui-badge-dot: currentColor;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-badge-border);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-badge-bg);
    color: var(--ui-badge-fg);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-badge:is(a[href], button) { cursor: pointer; outline: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  .ui-badge:is(a[href], button):focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-badge:is(a[href], button):hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-badge-bg) 86%, var(--ui-foreground)); }
  }
  .ui-badge > svg { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* Neutral variants */
  .ui-badge-secondary { --ui-badge-bg: var(--ui-secondary); --ui-badge-fg: var(--ui-secondary-foreground); }
  .ui-badge-outline {
    --ui-badge-bg: transparent;
    --ui-badge-fg: var(--ui-foreground);
    --ui-badge-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-badge-outline:is(a[href], button):hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }

  /* Status tones: tint + -text colour (fills fail contrast as text in dark mode) */
  .ui-badge-success { --ui-badge-tone: var(--ui-success); --ui-badge-text: var(--ui-success-text); --ui-badge-on: var(--ui-success-foreground); }
  .ui-badge-warning { --ui-badge-tone: var(--ui-warning); --ui-badge-text: var(--ui-warning-text); --ui-badge-on: var(--ui-warning-foreground); }
  .ui-badge-destructive { --ui-badge-tone: var(--ui-destructive); --ui-badge-text: var(--ui-destructive-text); --ui-badge-on: var(--ui-destructive-foreground); }
  .ui-badge-info { --ui-badge-tone: var(--ui-info); --ui-badge-text: var(--ui-info-text); --ui-badge-on: var(--ui-info-foreground); }
  .ui-badge-success,
  .ui-badge-warning,
  .ui-badge-destructive,
  .ui-badge-info {
    --ui-badge-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-badge-tone) 10%, transparent);
    --ui-badge-fg: var(--ui-badge-text);
    --ui-badge-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-badge-tone) 24%, transparent);
    --ui-badge-dot: var(--ui-badge-tone);
  }
  .ui-badge-solid.ui-badge-success,
  .ui-badge-solid.ui-badge-warning,
  .ui-badge-solid.ui-badge-destructive,
  .ui-badge-solid.ui-badge-info {
    --ui-badge-bg: var(--ui-badge-tone);
    --ui-badge-fg: var(--ui-badge-on);
    --ui-badge-border: transparent;
    --ui-badge-dot: currentColor;
  }

  /* Sizes */
  .ui-badge-sm { height: 1.25rem; gap: 0.25rem; padding-inline: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-badge-lg { height: 1.75rem; gap: 0.5rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .ui-badge-lg > svg { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; }

  /* Status dot; live adds a ring that expands and fades */
  .ui-badge-dot {
    position: relative;
    width: 0.375rem;
    height: 0.375rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-badge-dot);
  }
  .ui-badge[data-live] .ui-badge-dot::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: inherit;
    animation: ui-badge-ping 1.8s var(--ui-ease-out) infinite;
  }
  .ui-badge-sm .ui-badge-dot { width: 0.3125rem; height: 0.3125rem; }
  .ui-badge-lg .ui-badge-dot { width: 0.4375rem; height: 0.4375rem; }

  /* Remove button (BadgeRemove): small glyph, 24px hit area via ::after */
  .ui-badge-remove {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    margin-inline: -0.25rem -0.375rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    opacity: 0.7;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-badge-remove::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -0.25rem; }
  .ui-badge-remove > svg { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-badge-remove:active { transform: scale(0.88); }
  .ui-badge-remove:focus-visible { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 70%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-badge-remove:hover { opacity: 1; background-color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 14%, transparent); }
  }
  .ui-badge-sm .ui-badge-remove { margin-inline-end: -0.25rem; }
  .ui-badge-lg .ui-badge-remove { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; margin-inline-end: -0.5rem; }

  /* Anchor: pins the badge to the top-right corner of the element beside it */
  .ui-badge-anchor { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-badge-anchor > .ui-badge {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: 0;
    inset-inline-end: 0;
    translate: 40% -40%;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 1.25rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ui-background);
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: var(--animate-pop);
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-badge-anchor > .ui-badge { translate: -40% -40%; }
}

@keyframes ui-badge-ping {
  0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.55; }
  70%, 100% { transform: scale(2.6); opacity: 0; }
}
```

## Usage

**Variants and sizes** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/badge/variants.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';

export default function BadgeVariants() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <Badge>Default</Badge>
        <Badge variant="secondary">Secondary</Badge>
        <Badge variant="outline">Outline</Badge>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <Badge size="sm">Small</Badge>
        <Badge>Medium</Badge>
        <Badge size="lg">Large</Badge>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
